description: Create a flashcard template (block layout). If layout includes audio: ask the user for voice first, then pass voice_id OR audio_language + audio_gender (same as create_card). Requires hosted MCP with API key.

audio_language.description: ISO 639 with audio_gender when voice_id omitted

block_types.description: Ordered type keys or numeric ids; use list_template_block_types first

voice_id.description: Curated ElevenLabs voice id when template has audio

name: create_template
